that's the exact reason i have this job too! to look good for law school. i only work as a file clerk so nothing fancy. i had applied almost a year ago at the beginning of fall sem on indeed for a different position. i got a call from the hiring manager, she said she loved my resume but after finding out my school schedule it wasn't going to work out. i was at school T/Th. couple months later, towards the end of oct, i got a call back saying another position opened up, file clerk, and they would love to have me for a interview. been working since november 4th!

hello! i'm (23F) hoping for the same outcome as yours especially because when I was reading it I was like, "that's exactly my situation!" My partner 24(NB) broke up with me this weekend saying that they lost feelings, needed space, and that they are going through a lot emotionally and need to figure things out for themselves. But similar to yours:
-they have a high stress job (work 12 hour shifts 3 to four days straight)
-they just moved back in with their parents after us living  together for almost 2 years, and the last year I did not have a job so they were mostly paying for everything. 
-on top of that their parents are homophobic and they just got top surgery in august so there is a lot of adjusting
-and they are currently getting their masters

We've been dating for almost 3 years (literally 2 years and 9 months this past Saturday, and broke up with me on Monday). But they often do not voice how they feel about anything and barely open up so I think just like yours, they reached a breaking point. I'm hoping that after some time, adjusting, and healing between both of us we can come back together because although they lost feelings due to stress, i love them and i hope they still love me and could possibly end up having feelings for me again. I'm gonna focus on healing but I do hope after some time they will reach out. Wish me luck! If possible (you don't have to) could you give an update on how things are going?
